player_prompt.intro:
Tadakkest daɣ Countdown iwan n umzawal!
Tawala: Ktuɣ tamatart n imḍanen s +, -, *, / akken ad taweḍ taɣda.
Aselkem n tawla: [i j op] anda i,j d tiktiwin n imḍanen, op d tawla.
Umalal: [0 2 *] isɣuri uṭṭun n imḍanen 0 d uṭṭun n imḍanen 2.
Aɣzaf s wakka ad yili d uṭṭun kamal.
